## Cal-Maine Foods Schedules First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Release, Conference Call and Webcast


September 9, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.calmainefoods.com/node/14996/pdf)


RIDGELAND, Miss., Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. (Nasdaq: CALM) (“Cal-Maine Foods,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “company”), the largest egg company in the United States and a leading player in the egg-based food industry, today announced it will report results for its fiscal 2027 first quarter at approximately 6:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, September 30, 2026. The earnings release will be available on the Cal-Maine Foods website at[https://investors.calmainefoods.com/press-releases](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3Ui3DTbJwsX1YU0BIcMEqZzpPP_1ecLTkwYIAQjsnSjjHQzoymQyiilE6MjnVOARW-Ud79N5UyMgPMJNYi4QR8xSxcmJTZfrdanl6jWxNjW0kyT0R7ZRVhA99K8aQjOL6Wiu1OJppectl-ZQ8g1Yr3aH2fX0lPZ2QH7Nx2XBYKA=) .


Management will review the results during a conference call and webcast at 9:00 a.m. ET the same day. Participants can access the live webcast on the Investor Relations page of the Cal-Maine Foods website at[https://investors.calmainefoods.com/events-presentation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Y_DbrcKvhAbcvoqZcZs6amw4PyewoudVP5G_KX22ipJ7TDZI1VZS86ZmRACZ-I2ejUjqjCZHklLRLCmc4jht_QHUMFovV5iYcxG1fRn56CGtwLAezww0ud8KtnJLjVQamPssTGn1YkVlh8cg0M8mRuO_RJ43dWD-3PCw3DF1Dg5SAoTHVwVebh98RoMjqUww) .


To join by telephone, participants can register in advance[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4wfW9EiYHOGPOMgZSIbL7jH4928KRLgtFrg1qapvV3ETuCTf3NGL0PsoUjYW2mZlY6qdgvOP6p0cwGYL7JmXRN3oTs_MfBaHguGhne5tMvE1ctnkAe8yedGxwqmK3TzWQlSYnGwa-P6ehCTd7Vg7QzgQIAfxR9cRHf19pud4BDw=) . Upon registering, participants will receive the dial-in info and a unique PIN to join the call, as well as an email confirmation with the details.


A replay of the webcast will be available following the call on the Investor Relations page of the Cal-Maine Foods website at[https://investors.calmainefoods.com/events-presentation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Y_DbrcKvhAbcvoqZcZs6amw4PyewoudVP5G_KX22ipJ7TDZI1VZS86ZmRACZ-I2ejUjqjCZHklLRLCmc4jht_ViCsCsb-sWe5tk2UtP22EJhlgmN8wOIHOGZ3o1jrsaWjFzWj9qagceurKBxo81hZO-btuR3THn66t_kL0S8vDYaa-uJzpi2eruhgdNkTZnt) .


**About Cal-Maine Foods**


[Cal-Maine Foods, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9EvJl-B_Xs9kxH_2-4AVQZrTO4TQ55ck1hO_3loBsePpzqmywbK-2iR_3G09szHdCZKI8F1iQTWE0oZGLkgB-a6cmVzG2SFBVgvV0eLzKIMtBkW1ppy7h4XbzlnKqJnx) (Nasdaq: CALM) is the largest egg company in the United States and a leading player in the egg-based food industry. With a strong national footprint, Cal-Maine Foods provides nutritious, affordable, and sustainable protein to millions of households every day.


The company’s portfolio spans the full egg value ladder—from conventional to specialty, including cage-free, organic, brown, free-range, pasture-raised, and nutritionally enhanced—serving both retail and foodservice customers nationwide. Cal-Maine Foods also participates in the growing prepared foods sector, with offerings such as pre-cooked egg patties, omelets, folded and scrambled egg formats, hard-cooked eggs, pancakes, waffles, and specialty wraps. Its branded portfolio includes Eggland’s Best®, Land O’Lakes®, Farmhouse Eggs®, 4Grain®, Sunups®, Sunny Meadow®, MeadowCreek Foods®, Van’s®, and Crepini®.


Headquartered in Ridgeland, Mississippi, Cal-Maine’s strategy combines scale, operational excellence, and financial discipline with a commitment to innovation and sustainability, to enable the company to deliver trusted nutrition, enduring partnerships, and long-term value for its stakeholders.
